title: Roamhaven Rewards Membership Terms Schedule: Enrollment and Account Standing
content:
The enrollment and account-standing terms of Roamhaven Rewards are the same on every tier.

| Term | Value (all six tiers, Rewards Member to Rewards Ambassador) |
|---|---|
| Youngest age to enroll | 18 years |
| How enrollment is confirmed | Email confirmation link |
| Calendar days to confirm enrollment | 14 |
| Grounds for suspending a membership | Fraud review; terms breach |
| Business days within which a suspension review is decided | 10 |
| Credits frozen while suspended (no credit earned, redeemed or reinstated) | Yes |
| Closing the membership forfeits the balance | Yes |

## Notes to the schedule

- **Age.** A guest enrolls at 18 years of age or older.
- **Confirmation.** Enrollment is confirmed through the email confirmation link, within 14 calendar days.
- **Suspension grounds.** The two grounds are a fraud review and a terms breach.
- **Review period.** A suspension review is decided within 10 business days.
- **Frozen credits.** While a membership is suspended, no credit is earned, redeemed or reinstated.
- **Closure.** When a membership is closed, its credit balance is forfeited.
